~also we don't need workerCancel? error group will automatically cancel the derived context when wg.Go returns error~

I just remember workerCancel is used to notify workers that all job is finished when no error happens
also used to cancel worker when retry count of some job exhausted
seems we don't need firstErr, because error group can maintain first error.
there is a routine above managing job wait and retry, we need it for now, below too
